_note: The invite draw for returning players (components/draw/DrawPopup, admin: /admin/draw). Invite friends on WhatsApp with your link (?ref=you); a friend counts once they sign up with it during the campaign, verify their email and play joinMinutes. Every `target` friends is one entry; the winner is drawn at random by entries after endsAt (admin_draw_pick). The prize is real money (AED, paid by bank transfer after ID checks: /prize-rules#draw). returningAfterHours: who sees the popup (accounts older than this). Mirrored exactly by draw_config() in *_invite_draw.sql, checked by scripts/check-life-config.mjs.
